> Part 2, based on #41794. Review `45657adf5e` (633 lines). Compare: https://github.com/yuychang/sglang/compare/k3-pr1-quark-weights...up/b3-mla-gate-q-cache


## AITER prerequisites

None beyond AITER main. The fused launch is `aiter.fused_qk_rope_concat_and_cache_mla`, which main already exports, including `q_scale`.

## Motivation

Kimi-K3's MLA has no RoPE, but decode still builds the query (`q_nope` absorbed + `q_pe`) and writes the latent KV cache as separate launches before attention.

## Modifications

**`45657adf5e` fuse the ROCm MLA decode Q build and latent KV cache write**
- Add an AITER adapter that writes the identity-RoPE MLA query and the latent KV cache in one launch on gfx950.
- Call it from the ROCm MLA decode and target-verify path through a mixin hook that other MLA models leave as a no-op.
- Fuse only for Gluon and Triton decode, which take the 12-head BF16 Q as written; ASM decode keeps the split chain.
- Write Q into a persistent grow-and-retain buffer so CUDA graph replays reuse the same storage.
- Pass all-zero positions to both kernels so no read leaves the one-row identity cos/sin tables.
- Fall back to the Triton fused rope/cache kernel when the AITER op or gfx950 is missing.
- Keep Gluon MLA decode on BF16 Q only and gate the path behind SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_MLA_Q_CACHE_FUSION, off by default.
- Add numerical tests for the adapter and document the switch.

Switch: `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_MLA_Q_CACHE_FUSION`. Everything is ROCm only; CUDA and other checkpoints keep the existing path.

## Accuracy Tests

GSM8K, 5-shot, 1319 questions, same server as the speed test:

| Base (flag off) | This PR (flag on) |
|---:|---:|
| 0.943 | 0.951 |

GSM8K varies by about 0.01 between runs of the same serving code on this setup (0.922 to 0.943 over repeats of one branch), so a difference of that size is noise.

MI355X x8, TP8, `/data/models/Kimi-K3-Quark-MXFP4-AttnFP8`, sgl-project `main` at `d2a436446c` plus this stack. +"""Fail-closed adapter for Kimi-K3's fused MLA Q materialization and cache write."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import functools
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_hip
+
+_KV_LORA_RANK = 512
+_PE_DIM = 64
+_HEAD_DIM = _KV_LORA_RANK + _PE_DIM
+_FP8_DTYPES = (torch.float8_e4m3fn, torch.float8_e4m3fnuz)
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def _op():
+    try:
+        import aiter
+
+        return aiter.fused_qk_rope_concat_and_cache_mla
+    except (AttributeError, ImportError):
+        return None
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def _is_gfx950() -> bool:
+    try:
+        from aiter.jit.utils.chip_info import get_gfx_runtime
+
+        return get_gfx_runtime() == "gfx950"
+    except (AssertionError, ImportError, KeyError, RuntimeError):
+        return False
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def available() -> bool:
+    return is_hip() and torch.cuda.is_available() and _is_gfx950() and _op() is not None
+
+
+def covered(
+    q_nope: torch.Tensor,
+    q_pe: torch.Tensor,
+    k_nope: torch.Tensor,
+    k_pe: torch.Tensor,
+    kv_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    slot_mapping: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    k_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    cos_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    sin_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+    q_scale: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+) -> bool:
+    if not available() or q_nope.device.type != "cuda" or q_nope.ndim != 3:
+        return False
+    tokens, heads, _ = q_nope.shape
+    q_scale = k_scale if q_scale is None else q_scale
+    return (
+        tokens > 0
+        and q_nope.shape == (tokens, heads, _KV_LORA_RANK)
+        and q_pe.shape == (tokens, heads, _PE_DIM)
+        and k_nope.shape == (tokens, 1, _KV_LORA_RANK)
+        and k_pe.shape == (tokens, 1, _PE_DIM)
+        and all(
+            x.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and x.stride(-1) == 1
+            for x in (q_nope, q_pe, k_nope, k_pe)
+        )
+        and kv_cache.ndim in (3, 4)
+        and kv_cache.shape[-1] == _HEAD_DIM
+        and kv_cache.dtype in (torch.bfloat16, *_FP8_DTYPES)
+        and slot_mapping.shape == (tokens,)
+        # AITER's gfx950 kernels take one int64 slot and position per token.
+        and slot_mapping.dtype == torch.int64
+        and slot_mapping.stride(0) == 1
+        and positions.shape == (tokens,)
+        and positions.dtype == torch.int64
+        and positions.stride(0) == 1
+        and k_scale.numel() == 1
+        and k_scale.dtype == torch.float32
+        and k_scale.device == q_nope.device
+        and q_scale.numel() == 1
+        and q_scale.dtype == torch.float32
+        and q_scale.device == q_nope.device
+        and cos_cache.shape == (1, _PE_DIM // 2)
+        and sin_cache.shape == (1, _PE_DIM // 2)
+        and cos_cache.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        and sin_cache.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        and cos_cache.device == q_nope.device
+        and sin_cache.device == q_nope.device
+        and out.ndim == 3
+        and out.shape[0] == tokens
+        and out.shape[1] >= heads
+        and out.shape[2] == _HEAD_DIM
+        # q_out and kv_cache dtypes are independent: AITER decode wants FP8 Q
+        # with FP8 KV, Triton decode wants BF16 Q with FP8 KV. Extra out heads
+        # stay untouched, so 12-head K3 can write a 16-head MLA pad buffer.
+        and out.dtype in (q_nope.dtype, kv_cache.dtype)
+        and out.is_contiguous()
+    )
+
+
+def run(
+    *,
+    q_nope: torch.Tensor,
+    q_pe: torch.Tensor,
+    k_nope: torch.Tensor,
+    k_pe: torch.Tensor,
+    kv_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    slot_mapping: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    k_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    cos_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    sin_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+    q_scale: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Write the latent KV cache and the MLA query into ``out``; callers check
+    ``covered()`` with the same arguments first."""
+    _op()(
+        q_nope,
+        q_pe,
+        k_nope,
+        k_pe,
+        kv_cache,
+        out,
+        slot_mapping,
+        k_scale,
+        k_scale if q_scale is None else q_scale,
+        positions,
+        cos_cache,
+        sin_cache,
+        True,  # is_neox
+        True,  # is_nope_first
+        compute_all_q_rope=False,
+    )
+    return out
